people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
translations.bsb: And when the demon had been driven out, the man began to speak. The crowds were amazed and said, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”
translations.kjv: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
translations.asv: And when the demon was cast out, the dumb man spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
